An '''energy conversion cell''',<ref name="SWS" /> also known as a '''power conversion cell''',<ref name="EGWT" /> was a power source. [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]]s were regularly modified to accept energy conversion cells as a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] source<ref name="SWS" /> in place of [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] or [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]].<ref name="SWS2E">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

[[Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation/Legends|Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation's]] [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Tower]] was equipped with eight energy conversion cells. As part of the [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] piece's firing process, the eight energy conversion cells, along with sixteen [[micropower router]]s, had to be charged up.<ref name="EGWT" />
